description_full: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc., is a self-administered real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership, acquisition, development and leasing of skilled nursing and certain other healthcare-related properties. The Company's portfolio includes 142 healthcare facilities with an aggregate of 15,500 beds, located throughout the states of Arkansas, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Missouri, Ohio, Oklahoma, Tennessee and Texas. The 142 healthcare facilities comprise 130 skilled nursing facilities, 10 assisted living facilities, two long-term acute care hospitals, one hospital and one medical office building. Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. was established in 2019 and was incorporated in Maryland.

financial_summary: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. is a small-cap real estate business with a $685M market cap on $155M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +19% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 9% against a 6% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically.
Accruals are elevated at -9.3% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 5.8× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 1.7× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 5.7% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 39% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 2.7× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
